official_definition: Lore-wise, this all-piercing arrow is a power given by Grandwalkers in return for Lykeios intense faith on them. Namely, as Lykeios serves under Zeus and Apollon, it is a power which utilizes the absolute strength of the Supreme Deity of Olym and the heavy archery mastery of Apollon.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Dragonshot] or [Dragonshot: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Dragonshot]", "give [Dragonshot]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
